posts.caption:
From hearing his music on repeat in my playlist to standing behind the camera and capturing him some moments feel bigger than the frame. 🎥🔥

Had the opportunity to work as a Videographer with Hip Hop Thamizha Adhi anna at the Meesaya Murukku 2 Success Meet.

Meesaya Murukku was something I grew up listening to. The songs, the energy, the vibe they were part of my playlist. And today, getting the opportunity to work with the same person behind those moments feels like a full circle moment in my journey.

Some artists you listen to.
Some artists you admire.
And some… you eventually get to capture through your own lens. 🎬🔥

Grateful to be part of this moment.
From the playlist to the frame — this one hits different. ❤️‍🔥
